problem_type: Post-publish cleanup failures on Windows turn a successful asset import into a reported failure
symptom: With the project folder in a sync client or scanned by antivirus, importing images (toolbar import, drop, paste) intermittently shows 本地素材复制失败，可点节点上的「重试导入」 although the file was already linked into the project; reproduced by tests/ux/windows-freeze-sweep.walk.mjs --held (a holder opens every new file with FileShare.Read for 300 ms).
direct_cause: persistUploadFile and copyNativeFileToBucket link the staged copy into assets/imported, then clean up in a finally block with an unguarded fs.promises.rm of the .nomi-upload-* staging directory (and uploadContentStore also unlinked the staged name with an unguarded unlinkSync inside publish). When another program holds a file in the staging directory, Windows rejects the delete with EBUSY/EPERM and the cleanup error replaces the successful result; moveAssetFile's rename of a freshly written file had no sharing-violation retry either.
class_root: Cleanup of scratch state after an asset is already published was allowed to decide the outcome of the import, and the one-shot link/rename steps treated a transient Windows sharing violation as a hard failure. The same environment change behind the manifest-lock contract (project folders inside sync clients) was never applied to the asset store.
affected_population: Windows users whose projects folder is inside a sync client (坚果云, 微力同步, OneDrive) or is scanned by antivirus / search indexer
Every native-path import: toolbar import, drag-and-drop from Explorer, paste of copied files, MCP import_asset, cross-project copy, video import after normalization
Generation-result localization that moves a freshly downloaded file into the project (moveAssetFile)
macOS/Linux are not affected: POSIX allows deleting or renaming files that another process has open
entry_points: persistUploadFile (content-addressed native upload used by copyAssetFile for upload kinds)
moveAssetFile (move a freshly written file, e.g. a downloaded generation result, into the project)
importNativeSourcePath video branch (transcode temp directory under os.tmpdir)

external_sources.purpose: fsPromises.rm maxRetries/retryDelay retry EBUSY, EMFILE, ENFILE, ENOTEMPTY and EPERM with linear backoff: the runtime's own answer to transient Windows sharing violations, used instead of a hand-written async retry.
Without FILE_SHARE_DELETE in the other opener's share mode, delete and rename of the file fail while the handle is open, which is why only Windows loses the import.

invariants: Once an asset is linked into the project, no scratch cleanup can change the import result
Link and move steps retry transient EPERM/EBUSY/EACCES before failing
Staging directories left by a killed process or a persistent holder are reclaimed by a later import, never by an in-flight one

invariant_owner_layer.why: Every asset-store path that stages or moves bytes ends in the same cleanup; scratchCleanup owns 'cleanup never decides the outcome' and the age-based reaping, while retry on the one-shot link/rename uses the repository's single retryOnSharingViolation policy.

door_reduction.why_not: The doors are the distinct places that stage or move bytes (content-addressed upload, native bucket copy, move of a written file, video transcode temp, decode-validation temp); each already existed and must keep its own staging. What changed is that all of them now end in the one scratchCleanup owner instead of five hand-written rm calls.

generality_proof: Every asset-store path that creates scratch state or moves bytes into the project now ends its cleanup through scratchCleanup (never throws after publish, Node's built-in rm retry, age-based reaping) and performs its one-shot link or rename through the shared retryOnSharingViolation policy, so a sync client or antivirus holding any staged, temp or source file can delay but not fail an import.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Cleanup after publish retries with Node's rm backoff and never changes the import result.
Reclaims .nomi-upload-* staging older than 10 minutes, leaving in-flight imports alone.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Staging removal failing with EBUSY no longer rejects the import (assetImportSharingViolation.test.ts); link retries EPERM; the staged name is still unlinked immediately so concurrent same-content imports keep deduplicating (projectAssetImportDedup.test.ts).
renameSyncWithRetry absorbs a transient EPERM from antivirus on a freshly written file; the EXDEV copy branch removes the source without failing the move.
The video transcode temp directory cleanup can no longer turn a finished import into a failure.
Already falls back to regenerating the preview when the scratch rename fails (asset-preview-adopt-failed is logged, the import succeeds); left unchanged.
Best-effort by design; appends that hit EBUSY are dropped and logged, they never fail a user action.

recurrence.reason: Any Windows user with a synced or scanned projects folder can hit it on any import; the timing is intermittent (depends on when the holder opens the staged file), so it recurs without a code change on the user's side.
same_class_scan: door-map removeScratchAfterUse removeScratchAfterUseSync reapAbandonedUploadStaging: 7 doors across uploadContentStore, projectAssetStore, localFileImport
rg 'renameSync|linkSync|unlinkSync|rmSync|promises.rm' electron/assets: every mutating fs call in the import pipeline reviewed; assetPreview already had a fallback
tests/ux/windows-freeze-sweep.walk.mjs --held: toolbar import failed with 本地素材复制失败 in one of two held runs before the fix

prevention.invariant: Scratch cleanup after publish never decides the import outcome; one-shot link and move steps retry transient sharing violations
prevention.failure_mode: Real failures before publication (copy, hash, binding checks, non-transient link/rename errors) still reject; cleanup failures are logged and reaped later
prevention.strategy: One owner for post-publish cleanup built on the runtime's own rm retry, the repository's single sync retry policy for link/rename, and age-based reaping of abandoned staging.

legacy_paths.rationale: The five hand-written finally/rm cleanups and the throwing unlink inside publish were replaced in place by scratchCleanup; no second cleanup path remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Uses Node's built-in fs.promises.rm retry options; no third-party runtime controls the asset store.

migration: No data migration. Staging directories left by older builds or killed processes are reclaimed by the next import once they are older than 10 minutes.
residual_risks: A holder that keeps a staged file open longer than the retry budget still delays cleanup; the directory stays until the next import reaps it (hidden only by its dot-prefix name, which Windows Explorer shows).
Not tested inside a real OneDrive / 坚果云 / NAS folder or with 360 / 火绒; the held walk simulates their share mode.
